reason: The text names several non-leader characters, including Zeruah (צְרוּעָה), Jeroboam's mother, described as a widow; Nebat (נְבָט), Jeroboam's father; Abijah (אֲבִיָּה), Jeroboam's son who dies while sick; and Naamah (נַעֲמָה), Rehoboam's mother. While prominent figures like Solomon, David, Jeroboam, Rehoboam, and Shishak (all kings) are named, as are prophetic figures like Ahijah and Shemaiah who hold spiritual authority, the text explicitly names family members who hold no leadership position. The presence of these named non-leader characters falsifies the claim.
